known_issues: App draft/preview frequently expires, requiring repeated rebuild/redeploy cycles.

existing_features.title: Make the app compile and run without errors by identifying and fixing any frontend build-time or runtime crashes caused by missing/empty React component modules, missing exports, or unsafe calls on optional values (e.g., calling methods on optional blob references).

Fix the authenticated routing so the correct dashboard is shown based on the signed-in user’s role: candidate users see CandidateDashboard, employer users see EmployerDashboard, and admins see AdminDashboard (when admin detection is available).

Ensure backend methods used by the frontend’s query/mutation hooks exist and match the generated candid interface (in particular: user profile fetch/save/customization, company pages list retrieval if referenced, and admin detection if referenced). Add missing backend functions or adjust frontend usage so calls do not fail at runtime.

projectName: Repair app build/runtime issues and restore correct role-based dashboards
